title: Four-Desk Classroom
description: One static classroom scene for the original education classroom program. Four complete existing pencil-channel bookwell desks in two rows and two columns are paired with four complete existing dining chairs turned exactly 180 degrees to face the teaching end. A whole two-foot blackboard and a whole open-rear teacher lectern remain complete at the rear teaching area. Four unique existing models, ten whole instances, original unit scale, untouched raw GLB attribute buffers and internal hierarchies/PBR. Only a connected scene-only floor and short cutaway walls are new. Central aisle, rear entry cross-strip, side spaces and teaching strip are conservatively empty and connected; all original finite ground soles remain on the floor. This is a multi-seat classroom layout, not the old single abacus table corner with a new label. One scene, zero new independent models. No educational performance, child age suitability, ergonomics, accessibility, seating capacity, load, safety, construction standard, writing, folding, opening or other functional claim.
